LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.7: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Creating and Performing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS.

Key inquiry question: when playing the scale of F major. What is the importance of applying technique when playing instrumental music?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the fingering of notes in the scale of F major,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. play the scale of F major from staff notation on a descant recorder,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. perform a solo piece in F major on a descant recorder, applying correct playing techniques,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. value playing music on the descant recorder. .

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. play the scale of F major from staff notation on a descant recorder,

   Descant Recorder helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. perform a solo piece in F major on a descant recorder, applying correct playing techniques,

   Descant Recorder helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. value playing music on the descant recorder. .

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Read, and interpret fingering charts to play the notes of F major scale. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Descant Recorder together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy The learner confidently reads and interprets fingering charts as they play the notes of F major scale.

• Creativity and Imagination: The learner plays simple melodies in 4

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner acquires self-discipline as they use digital devices to record performances for future reference

• Social justice: The learner and peers share roles fairly in executing musical duties towards playing the descant recorder.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety and security; learners observe safety as they clean and play instruments,

• Poverty eradication; learners learn different ways in which creative arts and sports can help with income generation.

• Self-awareness: learners are able to identify skills they are good at and connect them with their talents in instrumental playing.

Link to other Learning areas:

• Integrated Science: Understanding the science of sound production enhances the learner's comprehension of playing

techniques, especially regarding the impact on the quality of sound.

Main points to remember:

1. identify the fingering of notes in the scale of F major,
2. play the scale of F major from staff notation on a descant recorder,
3. perform a solo piece in F major on a descant recorder, applying correct playing techniques,
4. value playing music on the descant recorder. .
